description: Hash and encode text. Use when a task needs an exact SHA or MD5 digest, or text converted to or from base64, base64url, hex or URL percent-encoding, where a language model would otherwise guess the output. Cost: 1 credit per call.

algorithm.description: For hash: sha256 (the default), sha384, sha512, sha1 or md5.

digest.description: For hash: hex (the default), base64 or base64url.

format.description: For encode and decode: base64, base64url, hex or url.

input_encoding.description: For hash: how to read text. utf8 (the default), base64 or hex.

name: hash_encode
